auditBasis: Point-in-time assessment of the dirty current filesystem plus dated repository evidence; non-certifying and non-production-authorizing.

gateLegend.G0: Defined trigger, persona and intended outcome
gateLegend.G1: Identity, tenant isolation, RBAC and module entitlement
gateLegend.G2: Input validation, authorization context and safe errors
gateLegend.G3: Service-owned command, state transition and concurrency rules
gateLegend.G4: Transactional persistence, idempotency and data integrity
gateLegend.G5: Audit, evidence, provenance, privacy and redaction
gateLegend.G6: Downstream posting, reconciliation, close or integration contract
gateLegend.G7: Role-aware UI, accessibility, localization, recovery and robust states
gateLegend.G8: Tests, migration safety, observability, rollback and production evidence

statusLegend.verified_in_scope: Direct code, focused tests and a relevant local gate or workflow proof agree; production certification is not implied.
statusLegend.implemented_needs_release_binding: The principal implementation exists but browser, operator, provider, rollout or current aggregate evidence is incomplete.
statusLegend.partial: A material segment, handoff or user journey remains incomplete or inconsistent.
statusLegend.blocked_control: A repository-owned control or safety gate prevents safe promotion.
statusLegend.blocked_external: Completion requires real infrastructure, provider, credential, qualified reviewer or pilot evidence not present in the repository.
statusLegend.missing: The capability is strategic or commercially material but no complete workflow exists.
statusLegend.duplicate_or_orphaned: Competing routes, catalogue entries or implementations should be consolidated or retired.

priorityLegend.P1: Shared foundation or current vertical-slice completion
priorityLegend.P2: High-value core workflow completion and release binding
priorityLegend.P3: Operational pilot, provider or commercialization completion
priorityLegend.P5: Deprecate, consolidate or remove after compatibility checks

workflows.name: Identity, invitation, session and recovery
workflows.trigger: Registration, invitation acceptance, sign-in, password reset or session expiry
workflows.intendedOutcome: A verified person obtains a secure, recoverable session without crossing tenant or role boundaries.
workflows.recommendation: Complete invitation, recovery, session-revocation and browser failure-path evidence; do not redesign the auth stack during the workflow programme.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Invitation through recovery passes tenant-negative, fresh-auth, expiry, revoke, localization, accessibility and browser gates with operator runbooks.

workflows.name: Tenant, membership and organization selection
workflows.trigger: Organization creation, membership change or workspace switch
workflows.intendedOutcome: Every command and read is bound to one authorized organization and an auditable membership.
workflows.recommendation: Keep the existing tenant boundary; finish owner/membership lifecycle, suspension and browser-negative evidence before package enforcement.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Create, invite, role-change, remove, switch and suspend flows are tenant-safe, recoverable, audited and release-gated.

workflows.name: Users, roles, permissions and security settings
workflows.trigger: User administration, role assignment or protected-setting change
workflows.intendedOutcome: Least-privilege access is granted, reviewed and revoked with evidence.
workflows.recommendation: Finish access-review, role-change and denial-state evidence, then make role and entitlement decisions visible in the operating cockpit.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every privileged route and command has one canonical permission, a tenant-negative test, fresh-auth policy where needed and auditable grant/revoke evidence.

workflows.name: Module entitlement and tenant provisioning
workflows.primaryPersona: Tenant owner, support operator and billing administrator
workflows.trigger: Plan activation, module change, suspension or account provisioning
workflows.intendedOutcome: Only purchased and approved modules are available, with reversible and auditable provisioning.
workflows.recommendation: Treat this as the first shared-product control programme: reconcile the 408-surface registry, add durable entitlement lifecycle and shadow/provider reconciliation, pilot deny mode on one low-risk module, prove rollback, then ratchet enforcement. Never flip all modules globally in one release.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Entitlements have durable states, package provenance, activation/deactivation commands, leakage tests, reconciliation, observability, rollback and progressive hard enforcement with zero unexplained denies.

workflows.name: Governed master-data onboarding
workflows.owner: Data onboarding with customer, supplier and item domain owners
workflows.primaryPersona: Implementation operator and tenant data steward
workflows.trigger: CSV upload for customer, supplier or item master data
workflows.intendedOutcome: Validated tenant data is staged, dry-run, approved, committed through domain services and reconciled without importing financial balances.
workflows.recommendation: Finish this as the first current vertical slice: assign a canonical module, add sidebar discovery, require a separate approver for high-risk batches, complete robust browser states, adoption metrics and release evidence.
workflows.definitionOfDone: A new tenant can discover, upload, map, dry-run, maker-checker approve, commit and reconcile customer/supplier/item data with browser, accessibility, rollback and support evidence.

workflows.name: Schema migration, seed, backfill and controlled deletion
workflows.trigger: Schema change, environment bootstrap, backfill or retention action
workflows.intendedOutcome: Data changes deploy with provenance, zero silent loss, rollback or compensating recovery and reconciled history.
workflows.recommendation: Keep development migrations moving, but fail closed for production until the 13 destructive statements receive exact-hash owner approval or are redesigned; separately approve the configured development seed because it performs prefix-scoped deletes.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Fresh replay, deployed history, seed, backfill and rollback prove zero unapproved loss; every destructive statement has immutable approval and post-deploy reconciliation.

workflows.name: Settings, locations, terminals and registers
workflows.trigger: Initial configuration or operating-structure change
workflows.intendedOutcome: Locations, terminals, registers and governed settings are complete before dependent transactions begin.
workflows.recommendation: Preserve the protected settings boundary, add data-onboarding discovery and close browser/accessibility evidence for setup dependencies.
workflows.definitionOfDone: All required setup dependencies expose missing/ready/denied/error states and block downstream operations with an actionable remediation path.

workflows.name: Inventory master, movement, valuation, transfer and loss
workflows.trigger: Item setup, receipt, sale, adjustment, transfer, count or write-off
workflows.intendedOutcome: Quantity and value change once, with source-linked evidence and correct accounting boundaries.
workflows.recommendation: Keep the kernel; bind module enforcement and production evidence, consolidate legacy item routes, then reuse its event model for offline stock count rather than creating a second inventory engine.
workflows.definitionOfDone: All movement types are idempotent, source-linked, tenant/location safe, valuation-correct, reversible where permitted, reconciled and production-observable.

workflows.name: POS sale, tender, cash and fiscal truth
workflows.trigger: Cart checkout, tender, refund, void or close
workflows.intendedOutcome: A sale, payment, stock decrement and accounting/fiscal evidence form one controlled business truth.
workflows.recommendation: Keep the transaction kernel and focus on production provider/fiscal bindings, entitlement and operator evidence rather than rebuilding the checkout domain.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Online and failure-path checkout reconcile payment, stock, receipt, ledger and close evidence exactly once under production-like concurrency.

workflows.name: Offline POS capture, synchronization and replay
workflows.trigger: Network loss, queued local sale or reconnect
workflows.intendedOutcome: Offline work replays once, conflicts safely and preserves fiscal and accounting truth.
workflows.recommendation: Release-bind the proven replay contract and reuse its edge identity, queue, conflict and evidence primitives for future offline field workflows.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Disconnect/reconnect, duplicate replay, partial failure, conflict, device loss and recovery pass production-like browser, queue, audit and reconciliation gates.

workflows.name: Receipt, public receipt access and delivery
workflows.trigger: Completed sale or receipt resend
workflows.intendedOutcome: The customer receives a safe fiscal receipt through a configured channel with delivery evidence.
workflows.recommendation: Keep public receipt truth, but replace the default stub provider or explicitly disable and label unconfigured print/email/SMS channels. Add delivery webhook reconciliation and consent evidence before selling multichannel delivery.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every enabled channel has a real provider, idempotent send, webhook reconciliation, retry/dead-letter handling, consent, redaction, observability and browser-visible recovery.

workflows.name: Sales, customer and order management
workflows.primaryPersona: Sales operator and customer account manager
workflows.trigger: Customer creation, quote/order, sale or account update
workflows.intendedOutcome: Customer and sales truth is canonical, tenant-safe and linked to payment, inventory and accounting outcomes.
evidence: current module inventory: legacy customerActions and customerAction2 mapping findings
workflows.recommendation: Choose one customer command surface, migrate legacy actions behind it, repair registry ownership/permissions and define the order lifecycle before adding loyalty features.
workflows.definitionOfDone: One canonical service/action/UI path owns customer and order states; legacy callers are migrated, permissions mapped, PII controlled and downstream payment/inventory/accounting contracts reconciled.

workflows.name: Customer statement, promise, dispute and settlement
workflows.trigger: Statement publication, recipient access, promise or dispute
workflows.intendedOutcome: A customer can view a frozen statement and submit a controlled response without mutating ledger truth.
components: public statement and recipient action surfaces
workflows.recommendation: Keep the verified public boundary; complete recipient resolution, statement generation/delivery, payment handoff and posting/reconciliation without letting public actions alter ledger truth directly.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Generation through delivery, token access, response, internal resolution, payment/reconciliation and closure is traceable, redacted, idempotent and browser-tested.

workflows.name: Supplier master and supplier-risk lifecycle
workflows.trigger: Supplier create, edit, review or activation
workflows.intendedOutcome: A tenant-safe supplier record supports purchasing and AP with change history and controlled access.
components: supplier list, create, detail, edit and history
workflows.recommendation: Keep the canonical purchases/suppliers route and redirect suppliersSystem aliases after telemetry and saved-link checks.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Supplier lifecycle remains tenant/RBAC safe and the legacy route is redirected without losing history, saved links or browser-state evidence.

workflows.name: Purchase order authoring, approval, receipt and conversion
workflows.trigger: Purchase need, order change, receipt or conversion to payable
workflows.intendedOutcome: A governed purchase order progresses through approval and receipt into AP and inventory exactly once.
workflows.recommendation: Make purchase-orders the canonical order lifecycle, replace or redirect the duplicate purchases detail pages, and remove hash-only edit/email/PDF/receive/convert controls after caller migration.
workflows.definitionOfDone: One route family covers draft-to-conversion with real actions, robust states, maker-checker, receipt/AP/inventory reconciliation, redirects and browser evidence.

workflows.name: Supplier purchase-order acknowledgement and change proposal
workflows.trigger: Buyer issues a signed supplier envelope
workflows.intendedOutcome: A supplier acknowledges or proposes a change through a redacted, revocable public boundary and the buyer resolves it.
actions: supplier acknowledgement and buyer resolution actions
workflows.recommendation: Release-bind the slice with real delivery, pilot acceptance and operational evidence; do not expand into a generic counterparty case platform yet.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Issue, deliver, view, acknowledge/change, buyer resolve, expire/revoke and audit work with real pilot users and production-safe delivery telemetry.

workflows.name: Accounts payable invoice, match, approval and payment controls
workflows.primaryPersona: AP clerk, approver and treasury operator
workflows.trigger: Supplier invoice or purchase-order conversion
workflows.intendedOutcome: A payable is matched, approved and paid with segregation of duties and reconciliation evidence.
workflows.recommendation: Keep the service-owned AP controls; add real payment-provider, browser exception and production operator evidence after purchase-route consolidation.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Invoice-to-reconciliation passes duplicate, mismatch, override, approval, payment failure, retry, reversal, close and tenant-negative scenarios.

workflows.name: Finance, cash command and cash-drawer operations
workflows.trigger: Opening, movement, deposit, close or cash exception
workflows.intendedOutcome: Cash position, drawer accountability and exceptions are current, reconciled and role-appropriate.
workflows.recommendation: Use finance/cash-drawer as canonical, redirect cashDrawer, and align cash command, daily digest and owner-war-room read models around one freshness/trust contract.
workflows.definitionOfDone: One canonical route and read model handles open-to-close, variance, approval, deposit, reconciliation and recovery with role/currency/workspace states.

workflows.name: Payment ingestion, settlement and reconciliation
workflows.trigger: Provider statement, bank/mobile-money feed or unmatched cash event
workflows.intendedOutcome: External cash is ingested, matched, suspended, resolved and signed off against internal truth.
workflows.recommendation: Keep matching and suspense truth; complete real provider ingestion, webhook/retry operations and production statement evidence before expanding predictive matching.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Real provider inputs traverse ingestion, normalization, match, suspense, resolution, sign-off, invalidation and close with replay, outage and reconciliation evidence.

workflows.name: Accounting ledger, journals and posting
workflows.trigger: Approved business event, manual journal or reversal
workflows.intendedOutcome: Balanced, source-linked entries represent business truth under the selected country pack.
components: ledger, journal, trial balance and control surfaces
workflows.recommendation: Preserve the ledger as server-owned truth; prioritize release evidence, posting-contract coverage and aggregate freshness instead of adding parallel accounting stores.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every material producer posts balanced, idempotent, source-linked entries; reversals and close locks are proven under concurrency and production-like migration.

workflows.name: Period close and close assurance
workflows.trigger: Daily or period-end close
workflows.intendedOutcome: All required evidence, reconciliations and approvals are complete before an irreversible close or certification claim.
components: close readiness, pack and evidence surfaces
workflows.recommendation: Keep the close kernel; finish production evidence, reviewer authority and stale-evidence invalidation across all upstream domains.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Close fails closed on stale or missing upstream evidence, requires authorized maker-checker approval, invalidates deterministically and produces a defensible pack.

workflows.name: Compliance and statutory country-pack lifecycle
workflows.owner: Compliance platform plus qualified country reviewer
workflows.primaryPersona: Compliance owner, accountant and qualified reviewer
workflows.trigger: Country activation, rule update, filing or statutory calculation
workflows.intendedOutcome: Dated, versioned and human-reviewed rules drive calculations without embedding legal assumptions in application code.
workflows.recommendation: Do not self-certify. Obtain the missing qualified Cameroon source-artifact approval, bind reviewer identity and effective dates, and rerun dependent accounting/payroll release gates.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Each active country pack has dated primary sources, qualified named reviewer approval, maker-checker history, effective-date tests, rollback and downstream recalculation evidence.

workflows.name: HRIS employee, contract, compensation, time and presence
workflows.trigger: Hire, contract change, compensation approval, attendance or leave event
workflows.intendedOutcome: A privacy-bounded employee record produces approved, effective-dated payroll inputs.
components: people, contract, time and attendance surfaces
workflows.recommendation: Consolidate the catalogue-only presence module into people/payroll unless a distinct commercial workflow is defined; finish employee privacy, self-service and browser evidence.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Hire-to-termination and time/leave changes are effective-dated, privacy-safe, maker-checker controlled and reconcile exactly into payroll input readiness.

workflows.name: Payroll calculation, register and payslip
workflows.trigger: Payroll period setup and approved input snapshot
workflows.intendedOutcome: A reproducible payroll run produces an immutable register and privacy-safe payslips.
components: payroll command center, register and payslip
actions: payroll setup, control, register and payslip actions
workflows.recommendation: Accept the newer isolated PostgreSQL proof as engineering evidence, but refresh the stale release aggregate and bind country-review, production DB and operator evidence before promotion.
workflows.definitionOfDone: The current release aggregate consumes the 9/9 trigger and 14/14 mutation proof, then payroll passes country, privacy, browser, correction, rollback and production operator gates.

workflows.name: Payroll declarations, payments, reconciliation and accounting close
workflows.primaryPersona: Payroll operator, treasury operator and accountant
workflows.trigger: Approved payroll register
workflows.intendedOutcome: Declarations, employee payments, liabilities, reconciliation and journals agree with the locked register.
components: declaration, payment evidence and payroll reconciliation surfaces
actions: payroll payment, declaration and reconciliation actions
workflows.recommendation: Keep development fail-safe, but require real declaration receipts, payment-provider statements, qualified review and register-to-ledger reconciliation before any production claim.
workflows.definitionOfDone: One locked register ties to declarations, payments, provider evidence, liabilities, journals and close with retry, rejection, reversal and operator sign-off.

workflows.name: Approvals, overrides and exception management
workflows.trigger: High-risk command, variance, override or control failure
workflows.intendedOutcome: Risky changes require the right independent authority and leave immutable rationale and evidence.
evidence: onboarding approval currently records the same generic actor without an explicit independent-approver rule
workflows.recommendation: Define a shared approval contract and a domain risk matrix. Require independent approval for financial postings, destructive imports, payroll, payments and high-risk master-data batches; allow explicit low-risk self-approval policies only when documented.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every high-risk command declares maker/checker policy, permission, freshness, expiry, reason, evidence, notification and revocation behavior with negative tests.

workflows.name: Evidence, redaction, document and export lifecycle
workflows.primaryPersona: Operator, controller, auditor and external recipient
workflows.trigger: Business event, report export, certification pack or evidence request
workflows.intendedOutcome: Evidence is immutable, source-linked, appropriately redacted and honestly labelled by trust level.
uiRoutes: accounting, close, assurance and reporting routes
evidence: graphify-out service god nodes hashBusinessPayload(), createAssuranceSourceHash() and evidenceGradeToBITrustState()
workflows.recommendation: Keep the shared evidence primitives, but establish one freshness/authority policy so later direct proof automatically invalidates stale aggregates and certification language remains non-misleading.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every report/evidence object has owner, source, version, freshness, privacy class, retention, invalidation, export manifest and permitted claim semantics.

workflows.name: Analytics, reporting, snapshots and decision support
workflows.trigger: Operational or financial decision, review or export
workflows.intendedOutcome: Role-appropriate metrics trace to trusted source data and disclose freshness and reconciliation state.
components: analytics dashboards and report trust states
evidence: module catalogue reports slug has no canonical /dashboard/reports surface
workflows.recommendation: Consolidate the standalone reports catalogue slug into analytics/accounting unless a distinct commercial package is defined; require one metric glossary and freshness contract before adding forecasts.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Each KPI and report declares owner, formula, source, grain, freshness, trust state, permission, reconciliation and export behavior with robust UI states.

workflows.name: Notifications, delivery failures, incidents and recovery
workflows.primaryPersona: Operator, approver, external recipient and support responder
workflows.trigger: Action required, delivery failure, control breach or system incident
workflows.intendedOutcome: The right person receives a deduplicated actionable notification and failures enter a recoverable incident path.
workflows.recommendation: Move notifications-demo behind an internal feature flag or remove it from production exposure; complete provider retry, dead-letter, escalation and operator ownership before relying on alerts as controls.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Material signals have owner, recipient policy, deduplication, delivery receipt, retry/dead-letter, escalation SLA, redaction and incident recovery evidence.

workflows.name: Workflow assurance control tower and runtime signals
workflows.primaryPersona: Control owner, SRE and release manager
workflows.trigger: Workflow execution, assurance breach, stale evidence or scheduled gate
workflows.intendedOutcome: Material workflows expose runtime health, evidence, incidents and release posture without replacing domain truth.
actions: workflow assurance, incident and control-tower actions
workflows.recommendation: Keep the runtime spine and complete scheduled execution, alert delivery, runbook ownership, SLOs and evidence invalidation. Do not let assurance aggregates override newer direct proofs silently.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every P0/P1 workflow has a runtime assurance definition, owner, scheduler, alert, incident/runbook, freshness rule, release gate and tested recovery.

workflows.name: AI copilot and agent control plane
workflows.owner: AI platform and domain control owners
workflows.trigger: Natural-language request, agent job or recommendation workflow
workflows.intendedOutcome: AI prepares bounded, explainable work while deterministic services and authorized humans retain business truth and approval.
components: agent commands, context and evidence views
downstream: domain workflows through approved tools only
workflows.recommendation: Freeze scope expansion. Complete runtime credentials, provider/connector health, production telemetry, evaluation sets, incident response and human-approval evidence before enabling consequential agent actions.
workflows.definitionOfDone: A narrow agent pilot passes injection, tenant-leakage, denial, cost, latency, approval, tool-failure, rollback and incident drills with no autonomous accounting or payment authority.

workflows.name: Public APIs, signed links, integrations, webhooks and business events
workflows.primaryPersona: External recipient, provider and integration operator
workflows.trigger: External request, signed-link access, provider callback or business event
workflows.intendedOutcome: External systems interact through explicit, tenant-safe, idempotent and observable contracts.
uiRoutes: public receipt, statement, supplier and referral endpoints
components: public access and integration error states
evidence: current API guard inventory: 16 routes, 2 support-evidence records, 6 review-required classifications, zero direct guard issues
workflows.recommendation: Reconcile the API and module classifiers before changing guards; then require contract versioning, idempotency, rate limits, webhook receipt/retry and provider health for every external boundary.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Every external route has declared intent, owner, auth/token model, tenant scope, schema version, rate limit, idempotency, redaction, retry/dead-letter and contract tests.

workflows.name: Enterprise release, observability, operations and rollback
workflows.owner: Release engineering, SRE and named control owners
workflows.primaryPersona: Release manager, SRE, security and business owner
workflows.trigger: Pilot or production promotion
workflows.intendedOutcome: Only a known source revision with complete evidence, secrets, migrations, operators, telemetry and rollback is promoted.
workflows.recommendation: Continue local development, but keep pilot/production fail closed. Assign named external evidence owners, approve migration hashes, complete managed secrets and credential rotation, prove schedulers/alerts/CI/runbooks and refresh all stale aggregate gates against one release revision.
workflows.definitionOfDone: One immutable release candidate passes all current gates with production environment evidence, named approvals, managed secrets, migration preflight, monitoring, incident drill and tested rollback.

workflows.name: Role-based operating cockpit and daily digest
workflows.primaryPersona: Owner, manager, cashier, accountant and operator
workflows.trigger: Daily sign-in, shift start or management review
workflows.intendedOutcome: Each role sees today's trusted state, blockers and next actions without navigating disconnected dashboards.
evidence: missing route role propagation without currency override
workflows.recommendation: Finish the two failing checks now, then consolidate dashboard/digest/action-center/war-room into one shell with role-specific views rather than adding more top-level dashboards.
workflows.definitionOfDone: All roles, currency/workspace propagation and loading/empty/error/degraded/denied/session states pass browser, accessibility and visual-regression gates on one canonical cockpit.

workflows.name: Customer referral attribution and pilot funnel
workflows.primaryPersona: Referrer, referred customer and growth operator
workflows.trigger: Referral link impression, click, conversion and activation
workflows.intendedOutcome: Consent-aware referral attribution produces a measurable, non-abusive growth funnel.
uiRoutes: referral public endpoint and internal funnel views
workflows.recommendation: Do not expand into loyalty or broad campaigns. Run one bounded real pilot and collect the 16 missing manifest, production query, delivery and end-to-end attribution evidence items.
workflows.definitionOfDone: One production-like pilot proves impression-to-activation attribution, consent, abuse controls, tenant isolation, delivery, reconciliation and metric trust.

workflows.name: SaaS packages, subscriptions, billing and lifecycle provisioning
workflows.owner: SaaS platform, finance and product operations
workflows.primaryPersona: Buyer, tenant owner, billing administrator and support
workflows.trigger: Trial, purchase, plan change, renewal, delinquency or cancellation
workflows.intendedOutcome: Commercial commitments drive auditable entitlements, billing, service state and customer communication.
services: module catalogue and observe-only entitlement service
stateModel: requested modules only; no durable subscription lifecycle
evidence: no general subscription, billing, package or provider lifecycle found
workflows.recommendation: Design only after entitlement states and catalogue ownership are stabilized. Start with package schema and provider-agnostic billing boundary, then provisioning reconciliation, deactivation policy, dunning and support workflows.
workflows.definitionOfDone: Versioned packages and subscriptions drive reconciled entitlements through trial, activation, upgrade, downgrade, delinquency, cancellation and reactivation with billing-provider independence and rollback.

workflows.name: Legacy routes, duplicate actions and orphan catalogue cleanup
workflows.trigger: Navigation, saved link, module packaging or maintenance change
workflows.intendedOutcome: Every capability has one canonical owner, route, permission and commercial identity.
components: duplicate route families and stub purchase controls
evidence: current module inventory: 408 records and 153 new baseline findings
catalogue-only slugs presence, reports, commercial_agents, content and administration
workflows.recommendation: Redirect before deleting. Canonicalize purchase-orders, purchases/suppliers, inventory/items and finance/cash-drawer; migrate callers and saved links; consolidate legacy customer actions; classify catalogue-only modules as internal, merged or deprecated before pricing them.
workflows.definitionOfDone: The registry has zero unexplained duplicate owners, unmapped enforcement candidates or sellable modules without canonical routes, permissions, services and lifecycle states.

workflows.name: Deterministic planning, cash forecasting and working-capital command
workflows.trigger: Weekly cash planning and scenario review
workflows.intendedOutcome: A transparent 13-week forecast uses reconciled receivables, payables, payroll and cash with explainable assumptions.
sourcePaths: future; reuse services/cash-command, services/analytics and services/snapshots
workflows.recommendation: Defer until onboarding, AP/AR/reconciliation and report trust are release-bound. Then build a deterministic read model before any predictive or AI forecast.
workflows.definitionOfDone: A reconciled, explainable 13-week forecast exposes source coverage, assumptions, scenario deltas, accuracy and stale/degraded states without posting accounting truth.

workflows.name: Offline field operations beyond POS
workflows.trigger: Inventory count, receipt or transfer under poor connectivity
workflows.intendedOutcome: Field work queues locally and reconciles safely into canonical inventory truth.
sourcePaths: future; reuse offline POS replay and inventory services
workflows.recommendation: Defer broad field operations. After core release, pilot only offline inventory count by reusing the proven POS queue/replay contract and canonical inventory command service.
workflows.definitionOfDone: A bounded inventory-count pilot handles device identity, offline queue, duplicate replay, conflict, approval, posting and reconciliation with zero second inventory truth.

workflows.name: Consent, loyalty and customer revenue lifecycle
workflows.owner: Customer growth with privacy and sales owners
workflows.primaryPersona: Customer, merchant owner and growth operator
workflows.trigger: Consent, purchase behavior, loyalty rule or retention campaign
workflows.intendedOutcome: Consent-aware lifecycle actions increase repeat revenue without creating untrusted customer or accounting truth.
sourcePaths: future; extend services/customer and services/referrals only after pilot proof
workflows.recommendation: Defer until the referral pilot, customer identity, consent and subscription foundations are proven. Avoid building a broad CRM, campaign suite or storefront now.
workflows.definitionOfDone: A narrow repeat-purchase use case proves consent, identity resolution, reward accounting, abuse prevention, opt-out, attribution and measurable retention before expansion.
